summary: Shard 69 is Australia-only (87 venues), dominated by Timezone/Zone Bowling plus a few independents. Shared lookups: ALL.Net maimai International AU (ct=1012) returned 47 live networked venues; ALL.Net CHUNITHM International AU returned 17; ZIv Australia API returned 192 arcades; official Timezone games directory lists venues across NSW/VIC/QLD/WA/SA/ACT (no NT). Highest-impact issues: (1) six ALL.Net-only shadow rows that duplicate richer ZIv venues (Bankstown 217=218, Braybrook 221=220, Preston 255=252 Northland, Macquarie 270=248, Southland 291=259, Garden City 295=240); (2) id 221 TIMEZONE BRAYBROOK has CRITICAL wrong-city coordinates in Sydney instead of Braybrook VIC; (3) Braybrook and Parramatta list CHUNITHM on ZIv/app but are absent from the official ALL.Net CHUNITHM AU locator (network status uncertain); (4) Top Ryde chunithm is confirmed by ALL.Net even though ZIv omitted it; (5) Zone 3 website 404 and 4-year-stale DDR Extreme; (6) Timezone Casuarina absent from official Timezone directory; (7) four official Timezone venues missing from the map entirely (Dee Why, Bunbury, Midland, Illawarra) without confirmed rhythm titles; (8) The Keys hours wrong vs official site. Many other Timezone venues match ALL.Net maimai/chunithm where claimed and recent ZIv (days-months old) supports multi-cab counts at major sites (Haymarket, Central Park, Knox, Tea Tree Plaza, Southland, Garden City, Chatswood). Could not fully verify every other-only suburban Timezone/Zone Bowling for permanent closure beyond directory presence, and could not obtain live Konami e-amusement data (Japan-only). Cabinet counts are from ZIv machine rows, not official SEGA counts. Other AU rhythm venues seen on ALL.Net (KOKO, Kingpin, Fortress, Paradigm Zone, Archie Brothers, etc.) already live in shard_066, not missing from the project.
